To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the stability performance of okra genotypes for fruit yield and yield attributing characters was not uniform across the environments and none of the parents or the hybrids exhibited average stability across the environments.
the cross combination HRB55 x D 18 5 can be recommended as a high yielding and stable hybrid for Kharif and Rabi season.
the cross combination HRB x D 1- 875 can be considered as elite cross for Kharif okra production.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the evaluation of 13 parents and 36 hybrids for stability of yield and yield attributing characters in three consecutive seasons under the same environment.
the stability analysis of 49 genotypes of okra.
the stability of fruit yield and its attributes in 49 okra genotypes.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
no single genotype was found to be uniformly stable across all environments and all the characters.
the genotypes should not be evaluated on the basis of stability alone.
there are no genotypes which are stable for all the characters, however, there are some genotypes which are superior for some characters and inferior for some other characters.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the genotypes which are superior with respect to fruit yield and other characters in one environment may not necessarily be superior in another environment.

, the cross combinations D 1 86 x D 1- 87, D 1-86 x D 2 88, D 1 -86 x D 3- 88 and D 2 86 x D-87 can be considered for further evaluation and breeding program for the improvement of fruit yield in okra.
the genotypes which were highest yielders in all the environments were not necessarily stable for the yield and other yield attributing characters.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the cross combination HRB55 x D1875 can be considered a promising cross combination and deserves merit as a high yielding variety for kharif season.

, in order to obtain a high yielding variety, it is important to select the parents that are high yielding and stable across the environments and the cross combinations that exhibit high mean performance and high stability.
, the cross D 1 85 x D 1 - 85 was found to be the most stable cross with respect to all the characters except number of nodes and fruit length.
